redCandidate.publicEntry: Localized published /superpowers/ routes and MkDocs localized navigation
redCandidate.setup: Read the three localized public migration pages and the checked-in MkDocs navigation configuration from the project root.

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const guides = ['docs-site/zh/superpowers.md', 'docs-site/ja/superpowers.md', 'docs-site/ko/superpowers.md']; for (const file of guides) { const guide = readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); assert.match(guide, /rex-harness/iu, file); assert.match(guide, /aios update --adopt-legacy-superpowers/u, file); } const navigation = readFileSync('mkdocs.yml', 'utf8'); assert.match(navigation, /Rex Workflow Migration:\s*Rex 工作流迁移/u); assert.match(navigation, /Rex Workflow Migration:\s*Rex ワークフロー移行/u); assert.match(navigation, /Rex Workflow Migration:\s*Rex 워크플로 마이그레이션/u); assert.doesNotMatch(navigation, /^\s+Superpowers:/mu);

redCandidate.expected: Every localized migration route describes Rex-only explicit legacy cleanup, and localized navigation presents the retained route as Rex Workflow Migration.
redCandidate.observed: The real public scenario exited with status 1 because docs-site/zh/superpowers.md remains the former Superpowers playbook catalog and does not contain rex-harness.
redCandidate.failureReason: The earlier public documentation migration updated only the English route while the localized route bodies and navigation translation keys remained active Superpowers content.
